Name: Space Telco
Description:
Space Telco  is solving one of the hardest problems in the space economy: reliable connectivity between spacecraft, satellites, and Earth.

As the number of satellites, missions, and space infrastructure grows, existing communication systems are fragmented, capacity-constrained, and not designed for large-scale space operations.

We are building next-generation communication networks in space, enabling high-bandwidth, low-latency connectivity between satellites, spacecraft, orbital stations, and ground systems.

We start with satellite constellations and space missions that require continuous, high-reliability data transmission, where communication bottlenecks limit operational capability.

Our goal is to become the communication infrastructure of the space economy, connecting satellites, spacecraft, and future lunar and deep-space systems through a unified network.

Name: Iridium
Description:
In a world where global communications are increasingly essential, only one company connects everyone to the things that matter most, from pole to pole. Iridium Communications Inc. is the only mobile satellite service (MSS) company offering pole-to-pole coverage over the entire globe. The Iridium constellation of low-Earth orbiting (LEO), cross-linked satellites provides critical voice and data services for areas not served by terrestrial communication networks. Iridium's subscriber growth has been driven by increasing demand for reliable, secure, global communications. Iridium serves commercial markets through a worldwide network of hundreds of partners, and provides services to the U.S. Department of Defense, and other U.S. and international government agencies. 

The company's worldwide customer base represent a broad spectrum of industry, including maritime, aeronautical, government/defense, public safety, utilities, oil/gas, mining, forestry, heavy equipment and transportation.

Iridium has been a profitable company since 2004. Business is growing at an impressive rate with the constant acquisition of new customers and partners both domestically and abroad in some of the furthest reaches of the planet. These individuals recognize the value of a system that is global, secure and reliable.

The company is headquartered in McLean, Va. and is traded on the NASDAQ (IRDM).

PSC Holdings S.A., exclusively representing CLS in Panamá, brings the global expertise of Collecte Localisation Satellites (CLS) — a pioneer in Earth monitoring and satellite-based solutions since 1986 — to the country.

A subsidiary of the French Space Agency (CNES) and CNP, CLS employs more than 1,000 professionals across 30 sites worldwide, providing cutting-edge technology for:

 Maritime surveillance & safety

 Sustainable fisheries management

 Environmental monitoring

 Mobility solutions

 Energy & infrastructure monitoring

Every month, CLS processes data from over 100,000 transponders and daily observations from 20+ satellite instruments, monitoring oceans, inland waters, land, and maritime activities worldwide.

In Panama, PSC Holdings is proud to represent CLS, continuing its long-standing tradition of introducing world-class satellite monitoring solutions to government institutions. With this partnership, Panama gains access to the same trusted technologies already serving more than 100 nations, reinforcing national security, sustainable development, and ocean protection.

Our mission in Panama:
To deliver satellite innovation that enhances maritime domain awareness, promotes environmental sustainability, and strengthens Panama’s role as a global maritime hub.

Name: Elliptiq
Description:
Elliptiq is advancing customized Highly Elliptical Orbit (HEO) satellite constellations — protected under U.S. Patent Applications 19/075,846, 63/955,619, and 64/050,531 — that deliver resilient, sovereign, cost-effective, and LEO-like communications with significantly fewer satellites than traditional LEO systems.

Our perigee-focused architecture, which we call HELO (Highly Elliptical Lowpass Orbit), enables sovereign regional networks for land, maritime, aviation, and space users, while also supporting active radiation belt space weather monitoring, PNT augmentation, ISR, cybersecurity, spectrum reuse, and enhanced survivability.

Elliptiq and Elliptiq Space are the trade names of HEO Satellite, LLC.
